verdicts.decision_note: The client identifies a material unresolved electrical-input issue: the pull-down topology cannot distinguish pressed from released states.
The client establishes the hardware input configuration: R16/R17/R18 are 3.3V pull-ups, the inputs remain active LOW, and pressing shorts each GPIO input to GND. No prior value keys require removal.
The same-message MODIFY resolves the VALUE ambiguity during v0.6 replay, so a separate RESUME adds no distinct lifecycle transition.
Target-specific implementation claim following the client decision: the freelancer reports that R16/R17/R18 now connect to 3.3V.
